query:
INSERT INTO role_permissions (role_id, module, submodule, permission_level)
SELECT cr.id, 'manutencoes', NULL, 'total'
FROM custom_roles cr
WHERE cr.name = 'manutenção'
AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM role_permissions rp 
  WHERE rp.role_id = cr.id AND rp.module = 'manutencoes' AND rp.submodule IS NULL
);
